title: 第20章 不死之躯第21章 小疗一下小查一下
content_zh:
“艾莎姐，你放心吧。邪帝没事，他有没有事我能不知道吗？”神君硬着头皮说道。
“对啊，艾莎姐。邪帝要是有事哪像这样啊？我都要急死了才对。”冰帝附和道。
“是啊是啊。你看嘛艾沙姐。除了一点皮外伤，别的啥也没有啊。”说着邪帝转了一圈，近看邪帝身上的雷击火伤，触目惊心。
三人一口一个艾莎姐，巧妙的周旋让仪器放不到邪帝身上。
“？你们到底要干嘛?把我的话当耳边风是吧？不检查是吧？那去医院。”艾莎看出来了，这三敢在她面前硬气了。
从小战神几人因修炼经常遍体鳞伤，都由艾莎亲自医治，区别于别人的对待，艾莎根本就没有把他们当天赐之名的帝君看，只当成病人。
艾莎实在是厌烦隔三差五就要救治，对着他们边骂边救，康复了艾莎自己都要先打他们一顿。
以至于几人实在是留下童年阴影了，哪怕艾莎现在修为仍然是神境初期。
是的，圣医院院长艾莎是位神境初期强者，比家主国君的实力都要强，自己也没有背景势力。
她本是一介散修，却凭借着自身的天赋和努力，历经无数磨难与挑战，竟然修炼到了神境初期！
要知道，在修行之路上，每一步都充满了艰辛和危险，但她却能一路披荆斩棘，不断突破自我，最终达到如此境界，实在令人钦佩不已！得老国君长者赏识担任圣医院院长之位。
“好好好，去医院去医院。”邪帝赶紧点头。只要不检查就好。
......
九天神国圣医院
“不是，咋还把我往手术室推啊？”邪帝躺在病床上，医护人员径直把邪帝推往空闲的手术室。
可现在哪还有空闲的手术台？
后边冰帝和神君仍再劝说艾莎不用管邪帝。
“院长！现在没有多余的手术台，手术台上的病人都是岌岌可危的人，一旦停止很难救回来。”
“不用管邪帝，真的！”冰帝说道。
“对的，真的不用管我！”邪帝附和道。

“你闭嘴，你都伤成这样，还不用管？你们几个人以前隔三差五就往医院跑，我还不知道你们？”艾莎怒了，这个邪帝真的是，冰帝也是，怎么做老大的？
“艾莎姐，那个......”神君话还没说完，就被艾莎打断了，“神君你也是，邪帝还是不是你兄弟了？”
“不信你看啊，艾莎姐。”只见邪帝从病床上撑起来，直接活动了一下筋骨，身上的伤口以肉眼可见的速度愈合了，坏死的皮肉自行脱落，直接长出新的血肉。
没过一分钟，邪帝的身躯便恢复成了原来的样子，根本就没受过伤。
不仅把艾莎直接看傻了，还有其他医护人员，以及姚晨昏等人。
“不是，儿啊，你这......这么变态了？”陈纵横有点摸不着头脑了。咋回事啊，自己儿子恢复能力如此离谱了？
根据神君所描述，有神境之上的力量与天道一起攻击了邪帝，现在居然跟没事人一样。
“你看吧，都说了不用管我，我去洗个澡。”邪帝从病床上下来。
“你这，好像真的好了。”艾莎皱着眉头，诊断过许多病人，自然一眼看出邪帝身上的伤口已经完全的痊愈了。
“以前怎么没发现你恢复能力那么强？”
邪帝心里撇撇嘴，wok，老子可是不死之躯，但嘴上说，“以前太弱了吧。”邪帝耸耸肩，洗澡去了。
“算了，没事就好。”艾莎也不去纠结了，原来刚刚他们说的是真的。
“既然邪帝没事，那我们也散了吧。各忙各的去吧。”姚晨昏说道，“陈兄，盛兄，冰帝丫头，神君贤侄，小女就交给各位了，陨石雨停了，也有我忙活的。”
content_en:
"Sister Aisha, don't worry. The Evil Emperor is fine. Can I not know if he is fine?" Shenjun said bravely.
"That's right, Sister Aisha. If something happens to the Evil Emperor, how can he be like this? I'm going to be so anxious." The Ice Emperor agreed.
"Yes, yes. Look, Sister Aisha. Apart from a little skin injury, there is nothing else." As he said that, the Evil Emperor turned around and looked at the lightning strikes and fire wounds on the Evil Emperor's body up close, which was shocking.
The three of them each had Sister Aisha, and they cleverly maneuvered to prevent the instrument from being placed on the Evil Emperor.
"? What on earth are you going to do? Are you turning a deaf ear to my words? Are you not going to check? Then go to the hospital." Aisha saw it, and these three dared to stand up in front of her.
Since they were little, the God of War and the others have often suffered bruises due to their cultivation, and they have all been treated by Aisha herself. Different from the way others treat them, Aisha does not regard their God-given emperor as a patient at all.
Elsa was really tired of having to seek treatment every now and then. She scolded them while rescuing them, and even after she recovered, she would beat them first.
So much so that the shadows of their childhood are really left behind for a few people, even though Aisha's current cultivation level is still at the early stage of the divine realm.
Yes, Aisha, the director of the Holy Hospital, is a strong person in the early stage of the divine realm. She is stronger than the head of the family and the monarch, and she has no background power.
She was originally a casual cultivator, but with her own talent and hard work, she went through countless hardships and challenges and actually reached the early stage of the divine realm!
You know, on the road to spiritual practice, every step is full of hardships and dangers, but she is able to overcome obstacles all the way, constantly break through herself, and finally reach such a state, which is really admirable! He was appreciated by the old king and elders and served as the director of the Holy Hospital.
"Okay, okay, go to the hospital, go to the hospital." The Evil Emperor nodded quickly. Just don't check it.
...
Jiutianshengguosheng Hospital
"No, why are you pushing me to the operating room?" Evil Emperor was lying on the hospital bed, and the medical staff pushed him directly to the empty operating room.
But where is the free operating table now?
Later, the Ice Emperor and Shenjun still persuaded Elsa not to worry about the Evil Emperor.
"Director! There are no extra operating tables now. The patients on the operating tables are all in danger. Once the operation stops, it will be difficult to save them."
"Don't worry about the Evil Emperor, really!" the Ice Emperor said.
"That's right, you really don't have to worry about me!" The Evil Emperor agreed.
"Shut up, you are injured like this, why don't you care? You guys used to run to the hospital every now and then, and I didn't know about you?" Aisha was angry. This evil emperor is really the same, and so is the ice emperor. How do you become the boss?
"Sister Aisha, um..." Before Shenjun finished speaking, Aisha interrupted him, "Sister Aisha, you too, is the Evil Emperor your brother?"
"If you don't believe me, just look at it, Sister Aisha." The Evil Emperor stood up from the hospital bed and moved his muscles. The wounds on his body healed at a speed visible to the naked eye. The necrotic skin and flesh fell off on their own and new flesh and blood grew directly.
Within a minute, the Evil Emperor's body returned to its original appearance, with no injuries at all.
Not only did Aisha look dumbfounded, but also other medical staff, as well as Yao Chenwen and others.
"No, son, are you...so perverted?" Chen Zongheng was a little confused. What's going on? Your son's recovery ability is so outrageous?
According to the description of the Lord of Gods, a power above the divine realm and the way of heaven attacked the evil emperor, and now he seems to be fine.
"Look, you told me not to worry about me, I'm going to take a bath." The Evil Emperor got down from the hospital bed.
"You seem to be really well." Aisha frowned. She had diagnosed many patients, and it was natural to see at a glance that the wounds on the Evil Emperor's body had completely healed.
"Why didn't I realize that you have such strong recovery ability before?"
The Evil Emperor curled his lips in his heart, wow, I am immortal, but he said, "I must have been too weak before." The Evil Emperor shrugged and went to take a bath."Forget it, it's fine." Aisha stopped worrying. It turned out that what they just said was true.
"Since the Evil Emperor is fine, let's disperse. Let's go and do our own thing." Yao Chenhuan said, "Brother Chen, Brother Sheng, Ice Emperor's girl, Divine Lord's nephew, and my daughter will be left to you all. The meteorite rain has stopped, so I will be busy too."
